position: Rights work has a visible, reversible preview flow
headline: Candidates can move between review lanes without ever becoming published sources.
copy: The queue begins from metadata-only fixtures, records role-labelled session events, and disappears on refresh unless a reviewer explicitly copies a packet.

postures.title: Role checks
postures.copy: Every transition evaluates a bounded capability.

postures.title: Audit
postures.copy: The page shows every session transition.

postures.title: Publication
postures.copy: Evidence-ready is not approved or published.

postures.title: Registry merge
postures.copy: No queue action edits the source registry.

flow.title: Filter
flow.copy: Choose a queue state and inspect evidence metadata.

flow.title: Assume role
flow.copy: Select a prototype source or rights reviewer.

flow.title: Route
flow.copy: Claim, route, hold, or mark evidence ready if allowed.

flow.title: Export
flow.copy: Copy the visible packet deliberately or reset the session.

decisions.label: Persistence
decisions.reason: The queue is a workflow prototype, not operations storage.

decisions.label: Approval
decisions.reason: No approve or publish transition exists.

decisions.label: Identity
decisions.reason: Audit events record role, not a verified person.

decisions.label: Production queue
decisions.reason: Needs database, auth, concurrency, retention, and audit guarantees.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, secret, or production runtime is activated.

locks.title: Write lock
locks.copy: No source, rights, reviewer, or learner write route exists.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Role simulations do not authenticate a person or grant production access.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Evidence-ready candidates remain blocked from publication and registry merge.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Pilot readiness evidence cannot activate an invitation or public service.
